name: dev-ba-kit
description: BA toolkit for developers — documents + diagrams (Claude Code plugin). Discovery documents (/brainstorm→/urd→/brd→/prd→/srs) + the full diagram family (Mermaid/PlantUML/D2/BPMN/draw.io) with unified validate gates. Two routers: /ba (documents) and /diagram (diagrams). More document waves landing: spec, wireframes, API integration, testing, traceability, delivery. Bilingual EN/VI. Scripts run as TypeScript via tsx.
